diagnosis: At 20:28:37 deploy-bot changed deployment/checkout env PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999 (revision 232). The payment service listens on 8080 (PAYMENT_PORT=8080, Service port 8080->8080), so checkout's calls to payment fail/time out. Checkout journeys went from OK to HTTP 500 and then ReadTimeout, while the other journey steps stayed healthy. Reverting checkout to the previous revision (231, which had the working PAYMENT_ADDR) restores the payment connection.
